newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end weaker, July breaks support.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end weaker, July breaks support.

text.p: FCOJ futures settled weaker and near session lows after a late bout of speculative selling knocked July under key 80.00 cents a lb, dealers said.

The contract ran into light sell stops and slid to the low of 79.60 cents, where trade buying emerged to stymie additional losses. Trading sources said the contract could fall further on Wednesday, and pegged near-term support at the recent low of 77.80 cents, hit on May 14.

July juice closed down 1.75 cents at 79.85 cents after trading from 81.80 to 79.60 cents. Second-position September settled 1.55 lower at 82.20, while the rest finished 1.50 lower to 0.70 cent higher.

The market opened weaker amid a lack of buying and local and speculative selling, sending July to an intraday low of 80.50 cents. Trade buying held the contract over support for most of the day, traders said.
An estimated 2,000 lots changed hands against Friday's official 976 lots. The market was closed Monday in observance of U.S. Memorial Day.
While market sources attributed today's losses to technical factors, they said the world supply and demand situation should keep prices under pressure in the longer term.
